feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 13 September 2026 6:12am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

Variable 2 or 3, settling South or SE 3 or 4 this evening or at first tonight, then veering South or SW later in the night.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather)##

Fair, then mist and fog patches developing tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds for a time.


##Wind)##

South or SW 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 later in morning, then 5 or 6 later in the day. Veering and decreasing West or NW 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building moderate, becoming slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##

Mist and fog patches at first, with rain then developing at times. Becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor, and falling very poor in any fog patches at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Tuesday, 15 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

West or NW 4 or 5.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Scattered showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in any showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Wednesday, 16 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds developing.


##Wind)##

West 4 or 5, increasing West or SW 5 or 6 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then outbreaks of rain developing for a time later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
##Thursday, 17 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

West 5 or 6, occasionally 7.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or moderate to rough.


##Weather)##

Scattered blustery showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C

15°C
